title: Bariatric Surgery for Morbid Obesity
procedure_name: Laparoscopic Roux-en-Y Gastric Bypass / Sleeve Gastrectomy
summary: Bariatric surgery is covered for individuals with BMI >= 35 with at least one major obesity-related comorbidity (e.g. type 2 diabetes, severe sleep apnea, refractory hypertension) or BMI >= 40, who have completed a structured non-surgical weight loss program and psychological evaluation.

sections.title: Indications
sections.content:
Open and laparoscopic Roux-en-Y gastric bypass and sleeve gastrectomy (CPT 43644, 43775) are covered when:
1. Body Mass Index (BMI) >= 35 kg/m2 with at least one severe obesity-related comorbid condition (Type 2 Diabetes, Obstructive Sleep Apnea, resistant hypertension), OR BMI >= 40 kg/m2 with or without comorbidities.
2. Documentation of prior participation in a structured physician-supervised or multidisciplinary medical weight loss program for at least 6 consecutive months within the prior 2 years.
3. Comprehensive multidisciplinary psychiatric/psychological clearance assessing patient stability and readiness for permanent dietary alterations.

sections.title: Contraindications
sections.content: Untreated active substance abuse within 12 months, uncontrolled active psychiatric psychosis, or inability to adhere to lifelong nutritional supplementation.

criteria.title: BMI Criterion (BMI >= 40 or BMI >= 35 with Comorbidity)
criteria.description: Documented BMI >= 40, or BMI >= 35 with at least one serious obesity-related comorbidity (T2DM, OSA, hypertension).
criteria.required_evidence: Physical exam recording patient height, weight, and calculated BMI with comorbid conditions.

criteria.title: Supervised Medical Weight Loss Program (>= 6 months)
criteria.description: Documented failure of at least 6 consecutive months of structured physician-supervised dietary and lifestyle modification program.
criteria.required_evidence: Clinical notes detailing monthly visits, diet plans, and weight trajectory across 6 months.

criteria.title: Psychological Evaluation and Clearance
criteria.description: Formal pre-bariatric psychological evaluation confirming absence of active substance abuse and psychological readiness.
criteria.required_evidence: Mental health evaluation report confirming clearance for bariatric surgery.
